snippet.title: Blooming in Budbury – Official Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Blooming in Budbury on Steam now:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/4595960/Blooming_in_Budbury/

Welcome to Budbury! 🌸 Step into a relaxing, cozy town life where you can grow your dream garden, befriend quirky village locals, and uncover sweet little village mysteries at your own pace.

Watch the official reveal trailer and embark on a wholesome adventure. 

Don't forget to add the game to your Steam Wishlist — every single wishlist helps us tremendously as an indie dev team! ✨

#cozygames #indiegame #gamedev #steam
